<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've received another message from Brad. He's saying that even with my corrected list of free slots for Priya and Marcus, there's no overlap with Elena and David's availability. He's asking me to re-check the list of free slots for Elena and David that he provided.

I already did this in my last session and concluded that none of them work for Priya and Marcus. Let me re-verify this one more time, very carefully, to make sure I haven't missed anything.

Brad's list of common free slots for Elena and David:
-   Mon: 11:00, 11:30
-   Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 15:00
-   Wed: 13:00, 13:30, 16:00
-   Thu: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
-   Fri: 13:00, 15:00, 15:30

My analysis of Priya's and Marcus's calendars:

Priya's busy times:
-   Mon: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
-   Tue: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00
-   Wed: 09:00-12:30, 13:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00
-   Thu: 09:30-10:00, 10:30-14:30, 15:00-17:00
-   Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00

Marcus's busy times:
-   Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00
-   Tue: 09:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
-   Wed: 09:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
-   Thu: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-13:30, 14:00-17:00
-   Fri: 09:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00

Now, let's check each of Brad's suggested slots:
-   Mon 11:00-11:30: Priya is busy (Travel). Marcus is free. **No match.**
-   Mon 11:30-12:00: Priya is busy (Contract review). Marcus is busy (Busy). **No match.**
-   Tue 09:00-09:30: Priya is busy (Board prep). Marcus is busy (Recruiting call). **No match.**
-   Tue 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy (Partner lunch). Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy). **No match.**
-   Tue 15:00-15:30: Priya is busy (Quarterly planning). Marcus is busy (Busy). **No match.**
-   Wed 13:00-13:30: Priya is busy (Client call). Marcus is busy (Partner lunch). **No match.**
-   Wed 13:30-14:00: Priya is busy (Client dinner prep). Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy). **No match.**
-   Wed 16:00-16:30: Priya is busy (Vendor meeting). Marcus is busy (Training session). **No match.**
-   Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya is busy (Busy). Marcus is busy (Contract review). **No match.**
-   Thu 14:30-15:00: Priya is free. Marcus is busy (Dentist appointment). **No match.**
-   Thu 15:00-15:30: Priya is busy (Client dinner prep). Marcus is busy (Board prep). **No match.**
-   Fri 13:00-13:30: Priya is free. Marcus is busy (Litigation strategy). **No match.**
-   Fri 15:00-15:30: Priya is busy (Hiring panel). Marcus is busy (Travel). **No match.**
-   Fri 15:30-16:00: Priya is busy (Contract review). Marcus is busy (Busy). **No match.**

My analysis is consistent: none of the slots Brad provided are free for both Priya and Marcus. We are at an impasse. We've exchanged our lists of free slots, and it seems there is no overlap.

At this point, simply telling Brad "no, that doesn't work" is not going to be productive. We need a more comprehensive approach. Since exchanging lists of free slots isn't working, the next logical step is to exchange lists of *busy* slots. This will allow each of us to have a complete picture of all four partners' schedules and find a common free slot.

So, my plan is:
1.  Compile a complete list of all 30-minute busy slots for Priya and Marcus next week.
2.  Send this list to Brad through the workspace.
3.  Ask Brad to combine this with Elena's and David's busy times to find a 30-minute slot that works for everyone.
4.  End my session.

This approach is more robust because it ensures that we are both working with the complete set of constraints.

I will now compile the list of busy slots for Priya and Marcus.

Priya Raman's busy slots:
Mon: 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30, 16:00, 16:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30, 16:00, 16:30
Wed: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 13:00, 13:30, 14:00, 14:30, 16:00, 16:30
Thu: 09:30, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:30, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30, 16:00, 16:30
Fri: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:30, 14:30, 15:00, 15:30, 16:00, 16:30

Marcus Hale's busy slots:
Mon: 10:00, 10:30, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:00, 14:30, 15:30, 16:00, 16:30
Tue: 09:00, 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:30, 12:00, 12:30, 14:00, 14:30, 15:00, 16:00
Wed: 09:30, 10:00, 10:30, 11:00, 11:30, 12:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:00, 16:30

I will now send this information to Brad.
